decisions.decision: Reject naive two-system DOVER-Lap fusion. Author explicitly warns equal two-way conflict retains both labels, usually degrading results. Save per-mic disagreements instead.

Cue-composable speaker/spatial design is a relevant architecture reference, not a deployable replacement. Current v0.1 is research preview, pretrained packages and inference CLI under validation. No dependencies or weights installed.

Use real conversational Mandarin/English and measure target word errors as well as voice identity and non-target leakage. Keep development/test separation; corrected challenge scoring is not a score guarantee for our pipeline.

Do not substitute the evaluation ResNet encoder into a192D-ECAPA cue checkpoint. Existing complete pinned author inference and strict tensor roundtrip remain authoritative for that failed experiment; no model retry from an ambiguous model-card note.
